subject: Feature scope exception for Strata pilot — request & gating
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@strata-analytics.com>, procurement@strata-analytics.com
Date: 2027-04-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Feature scope exception for Strata pilot — request & gating

Team,

Quick summary: Strata (deal STR-2027-042) just confirmed a pilot demo for 2027-05-01. They will only move to contract signature if we can provide a short-term, pinned model residency + a deterministic reranker/comparator endpoint for their QA tests. This is a one-off enterprise ask tied directly to a $1.2M ARR initial commitment.

Ask: Can Product/Eng greenlight an exception to our normal roadmap and deliver Phase 1 (pinned quantized model variant deployed to a single Dedicated node, exposed as a separate endpoint with invariant reranker input) by 2027-04-28 so we can validate before the public demo? Phase 2 (deterministic comparator with metric instrumentation) can follow after the pilot if we get the contract.

Constraints we heard from the customer:
- Model: 7B open model family is fine; they want deterministic reranker output for a fixed test set.
- SLA for pilot: p95 inference < 150ms for a 128-token prompt in our test harness.
- Security: log export (per-tenant audit) is required but can be a low-frequency dump post-demo.

Attachments: Milestone plan + MSA redlines attached.
[Attachment: strata-milestone-plan.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet)]
[Attachment: MSA_redlines_v2.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)]

Requesting: feasibility, high-level estimate (engineering weeks + risk), and list of blocking items by EOD 2027-04-16 so I can commit timelines to the customer. If this needs escalation, please flag and I'll push from GTM.

Thanks,
Priyom
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
pri...@redwood.inference.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@strata-analytics.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Feature scope exception for Strata pilot — request & gating

Priyom — thanks for the context. A few immediate clarifying Qs before I provide an estimate:

1) Exact model artifact: is Strata asking for a specific repo/model hash, or is a Redwood-curated 7B quantized variant acceptable?
2) Deterministic reranker: do they require bit-for-bit identical responses across cold starts, or deterministic scoring given the same logits?
3) Traffic: pilot traffic expected during the test window (concurrent requests) — any spike expectations?

Initial feasibility notes:
- Pinned single-node residency is doable as a scoped exception — we can pin a quantized 7B to one Dedicated GPU instance. Ops work: build a special config that disables eviction and exposes the pinned endpoint.
- Deterministic reranker/comparator is trickier: GPU non-determinism + quantization can cause small float diffs. We can deliver a deterministic reranking comparator by running reranker logic in fp16 on CPU deterministically or by using a fixed-seed beam that we control; this will add latency and complexity.
- Estimated engineering: 2 backend engineers + 0.5 SRE for rollout and runbook, ~2-3 weeks for Phase 1 (pinned endpoint + basic observability). Phase 2 (deterministic comparator and test harness) ~2 additional weeks with QA.

Risks/blockers:
- Dedicated capacity availability by 2027-04-21 for staging.
- Clear acceptance criteria from Strata (we need the test set and definition of "deterministic").
- Possible security signoff for the short-term log export.

If you can confirm model artifact and acceptance tests I will produce a short tech plan + tasks by 2027-04-15 EOD.

—Dev
Senior Engineer, Serving Runtime

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@strata-analytics.com>, procurement@strata-analytics.com
Date: 2027-04-15T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Feature scope exception for Strata pilot — request & gating

Thanks — read this through. Proposed product approach to limit scope and risk:

Proposal (Phase-gated):
Phase 1 (delivery target 2027-04-28):
- Pin a Redwood-verified quantized 7B model to a single Dedicated node, expose it as a separate "strata-pilot" endpoint.
- Provide a thin server-side reranker wrapper that accepts a fixed test-set and returns a scoring vector (not a full generation pipeline) so Strata can do deterministic QA. This avoids modifying core generation paths.
- Provide an ops runbook (how to warm KV cache, disable eviction for pilot) and a temporary log-export schedule (nightly S3 drop).

Phase 2 (post-contract, +2–3 weeks):
- Implement the full deterministic comparator with reproducible float-to-score mapping and integrated QA harness.
- Harden monitoring + automated fallback to hosted model if Dedicated node fails.

Tradeoffs: Phase 1 reduces engineering scope and minimizes impact to global routing — Phase 2 required for long-term SLA. We can ship Phase 1 as a supported exception; needs manager approval for Dedicated capacity and an ops owner.

If this sounds acceptable, I'll prepare the scope doc and break down tickets. HubSpot link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/678901/STR-2027-042

Appreciate the pragmatic split — Phase 1 aligns well with what Strata needs for the demo. I've attached an updated milestone with hard cutovers and acceptance criteria from the customer. If we can commit to Phase 1 by 2027-04-28 we will move forward with signature and a short proof-of-concept fee.

Notes from customer call:
- They will provide the 200-case deterministic test set by 2027-04-18.
- They expect nightly log export in CSV with request_id, prompt_hash, score vector.
- They want a non-production-facing endpoint for manual QA only (no public ingress).

Updated attachments: strata-milestone-plan.xlsx (adjusted dates).

Please confirm resource assignment and any remaining blockers. If we need to escalate for Dedicated capacity, Evelyn — can you confirm availability and budget approval?

Thanks,
Priyom

1) Assign 2 backend engineers (Dev + one more) and a dedicated SRE contact.
2) Dedicated staging node reserved by 2027-04-21; procurement will coordinate with capacity owners.
3) Ops runbook + rollback criteria documented before pilot go-live.
4) Budget: we will treat this as a capitalized pilot expense. Procurement to capture costs against STR-2027-042.

Priyom — Marissa/Dev, please produce a one-page runbook and ticket list by 2027-04-18. I'll escalate capacity if we hit blockers.

Evelyn
